keyword_contain.description: Keywords must contain all of these terms (exact match)

sort.description: Sorting by parameters (any field in urls section of response: url, keywords, traff, fbShares)

page_size.description: Number of results per page (allowed values: 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 200, 500)

domain.description: List of domains to filter, e.g., www.apple.com

sort.description: Order of sorting the results in the format: field: order (e.g., {"region_queries_count": "desc"})

size.description: Number of results per page in response

tools.name: get_keyword_top
tools.description: **DEPRECATED - use get_keyword_full_top instead.** GET Google top-100 positions for keyword. Returns: position, URL, domain, subdomain, SERP features.

top_size.description: The number of results to retrieve from the top search results

position.description: The exact position of the keyword in search results

position_from.description: The minimum position of the keyword in search results

position_to.description: The maximum position of the keyword in search results

minus_domain.description: Excludes results from the specified domain

tools.name: get_backlinks_summary

query.description: Domain, subdomain, or URL to analyze

searchType.description: Type of search query (domain, domain_with_subdomains, url, part_url)

sort.description: Sort results by field (url_from, anchor, link_nofollow, links_external, link_type, url_to, check, add, domain_rank)

linkPerDomain.description: Use this parameter **ONLY** if you need one link per donor domain

query.description: Domain to analyze for referring domains

sort.description: Sort results by field (domain_links, domain_from, domain_rank, check)

searchType.description: Type of search: domain, domain_with_subdomains, url, or part_url

sort.description: Field to sort results by

tools.description: GET top-10 anchor texts (quick overview). USE WHEN: fast anchor check, backlink snapshot. Returns: top 10 anchors with backlink and referring domain counts.

searchType.description: Type of search: domain or domain_with_subdomains

tools.name: get_top_pages_by_backlinks
tools.description: GET pages with most backlinks on a domain. USE WHEN: finding most linked pages, content analysis. Returns: pages ranked by referring pages, domains, IPs.

searchType.description: Type of search: domain or domain_with_subdomains

sort.description: Field to sort results by

tools.name: get_backlinks_intersection
tools.description: FIND shared referring domains across multiple sites. USE WHEN: competitor backlink gap analysis, finding link opportunities. Returns: domains linking to multiple targets with link metrics and authority scores.

query.description: Main domain to analyze for backlinks intersection

intersect.description: Array of competitor domains for intersection analysis

sort.description: Field to sort results by (domain_rank, links_count1, links_count2, links_count3)

tools.name: get_active_outlinks
tools.description: GET outbound links from domain/URL. USE WHEN: outlink audit, partnership analysis, checking external links. Returns: target URLs, anchors, link attributes (follow/nofollow), dates.

query.description: Domain name or URL to analyze for outbound links

searchType.description: Type of search: domain, domain_with_subdomains, url, or part_url

sort.description: Field to sort results by

linkPerDomain.description: Maximum number of links to return per domain

tools.name: get_active_outlink_domains
tools.description: GET domains that receive outlinks from target. USE WHEN: outlink domain analysis, finding partnerships. Returns: target domains with link counts and patterns.

query.description: Domain name to analyze outbound link destinations

sort.description: Field to sort results by

tools.name: get_threat_backlinks
tools.description: GET toxic/malicious backlinks. USE WHEN: disavow audit, threat detection, link cleanup. Returns: links from flagged sites (malware, social engineering, unwanted software) with threat type, source/target URLs, dates.

query.description: Domain to analyze for threat backlinks

sort.description: Field to sort by: lastupdate, url_from, url_to, platform_type, threat_type

linkPerDomain.description: Maximum number of links per domain to return

tools.name: get_url_summary_traff
tools.description: GET traffic and keyword stats for URLs matching a pattern. USE WHEN: section traffic analysis, URL mask analysis. **HIGH-COST: 1000 credits per output type (traffic|keywords). Confirm with user before executing.** Returns: organic traffic, keyword count for matching URLs.

domain.description: The domain for which to retrieve traffic and keyword data

urlContains.description: URL pattern to filter results. Must be at least 3 characters long. Method finds all URLs containing this substring and aggregates statistics. Examples: '/blog/' matches all blog pages, '/products/' matches product section, '/en/' matches English version. Cannot use '/' alone.

output_data.description: Specify which data to return. 'traffic' returns only traffic estimates (1000 credits). 'keywords' returns only keyword counts (1000 credits). If not specified, returns both traffic and keywords (2000 credits). Specify this parameter unless both metrics are required.

tools.name: get_url_competitors
tools.description: FIND competitor URLs ranking for same keywords in Google top-10. USE WHEN: page-level competition analysis, finding similar pages. URL must include https:// protocol. Requires 10+ keywords in top-10 (returns 'Data not found' for low-traffic pages). Cost: 1 credit/row.

url.description: Full URL to analyze including protocol. Examples: 'https://example.com/' or 'https://example.com/page'. The URL must rank for keywords in Google top-10 to have competitor data. New or low-traffic pages may return 'Data not found' error.

cnt.description: Sort by number of keywords in top 10 for which pages intersect

sort.description: Sorting parameters

tools.name: get_url_keywords
tools.description: GET keywords a URL ranks for in Google top-100. USE WHEN: page keyword analysis, content audit. Returns: position, traffic, difficulty, volume, SERP features per keyword. Cost: 1 credit/row.

url.description: Full URL to analyze including protocol (https://). Returns keywords where this exact URL ranks in Google top-100 (Bing top-50). Examples: 'https://example.com/', 'https://example.com/blog/article'

withIntents.description: Include keyword search intent classification (informational, navigational, commercial, transactional). When enabled, response includes intents array for each keyword.

sort.description: Sorting parameters

url_contains.description: Exact website pages ranking for keywords

keyword_not_contain.description: Does not contain all keywords (exact matching)

keyword_contain_one_of.description: Contains one of the keywords (exact matching)

keyword_not_contain_one_of.description: Does not contain one of the keywords (exact matching)

intents_not_contain.description: Does not contain one of the intents

tools.name: get_url_missing_keywords
tools.description: FIND content gap keywords (competitors rank in top-20, your URL does not). USE WHEN: content gap analysis, finding quick wins, keyword opportunities. Returns: missing keywords with weight (higher = more competitors rank for it). Cost: 1 credit/row.

weight.description: Sort by connection strength (number of competitor URLs in top-20 ranking for this keyword). Higher weight = more competitors = higher keyword value for your niche

sort.description: Sorting parameters. Sort by `weight` to see keywords where most competitors rank (highest opportunity)

right_spelling.description: Filter by spelling: true - contains all, false - does not contain all

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: CREATE new project for SEO tracking and audits. USE WHEN: starting new project, setting up monitoring.

domain.description: The domain associated with the project (e.g., example.com)

name.description: The name of the project. Can be the same as the domain or a custom name

groups.description: Optional list of groups to associate with the project. Groups will be created if they don't exist

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: DELETE project permanently. **CRITICAL: Request user confirmation. Cannot be undone.** USE WHEN: removing project.

project_id.description: The unique ID of the project to delete

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: LIST account projects. USE WHEN: viewing projects, finding project ID. Supports pagination.

page.description: The page number in the projects list

size.description: Number of results per page. Allowed values: 20, 50, 100, 200, 500

tools.name: get_credits_for_audit_stats
tools.description: CHECK audit credits. USE WHEN: before running audits, checking limits. Returns: one-page audit credits, JS scanning credits, page crawl limits.

tools.name: get_credits_stats
tools.description: CHECK API credits and usage stats. USE WHEN: monitoring usage, before expensive operations. Returns: credits balance, usage stats, account info.

tools.name: get_rt_projects_list
tools.description: LIST rank tracking projects. USE WHEN: finding projects, starting rank analysis. Returns: projectId, name, domain, creation date, status.

page.description: Page number in the projects list

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Allowed values: 20, 50, 100, 500

tools.name: get_rt_project_status
tools.description: CHECK position update status for project/region. USE WHEN: before requesting rank data, checking if data ready. Returns: parsing status.

tools.name: get_rt_project_regions_list
tools.description: LIST regions configured for project. USE WHEN: finding regionId, checking tracked regions. Returns: regionId, status, SERP type, device type, search engine, location.

tools.name: get_rt_project_keyword_serp_history
tools.description: GET full top-100 SERP history for tracked keywords. USE WHEN: competitor tracking, SERP changes analysis. Returns: positions, URLs, domains, volumes per date. **WARNING: large datasets. Use pageSize 20-50, date/keyword filters to reduce.** Supports keyword tagging.

projectRegionId.description: Region ID for the project. Required. Get from get_rt_project_regions_list method. Each project can track multiple regions. See region reference: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LUDtm-L1qWMVpmWuN-nvDyYFfQtfiXUh5LIHE8sjs0k/edit?gid=75443986#gid=75443986

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1.

pageSize.description: Number of keywords per page. Allowed values: 20, 50, 100, 500. RECOMMENDED: Use 20 or 50 to avoid response truncation due to large dataset sizes. Each keyword returns full top-100 SERP for all dates.

dateFrom.description: Start date of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-09-01'). Use to filter historical data and reduce response size.

dateTo.description: End date of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-09-30'). Use to filter historical data and reduce response size.

sort.description: Sort results by 'keyword' (alphabetically) or 'date' (chronologically). Default is 'date'.

order.description: Sorting order: 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first). Default is 'desc'.

withTags.description: Include keyword tags in the response. Tags are used to group and categorize keywords in the project. Set to true to receive tag IDs and values for each keyword.

tools.name: get_rt_project_url_serp_history
tools.description: GET YOUR domain's ranking history only (not full top-100). Unlike get_rt_project_keyword_serp_history, shows only where your URL ranks. USE WHEN: tracking own rankings, performance monitoring. Returns: positions, volumes, keyword tags.

projectId.description: Rank tracker project ID. Required. Get from get_rt_projects_list method.

projectRegionId.description: Region ID for the project. Required. Get from get_rt_project_regions_list method. Each project can track multiple regions. See region reference: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LUDtm-L1qWMVpmWuN-nvDyYFfQtfiXUh5LIHE8sjs0k/edit?gid=75443986#gid=75443986

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1.

pageSize.description: Number of keywords per page. Allowed values: 20, 50, 100, 500. Recommended: 100 for most use cases (response is much smaller than get_rt_project_keyword_serp_history since it only shows your domain's positions).

dateFrom.description: Start date of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-09-01'). Filters historical data to this date range.

dateTo.description: End date of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2025-09-30'). Filters historical data to this date range.

sort.description: Sort results by 'keyword' (alphabetically) or 'date' (chronologically). Default is 'keyword'.

order.description: Sorting order: 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first). Default is 'desc'.

keywords.description: Filter results by specific keywords (max 1000 keywords). Returns only data for the specified keywords where your domain ranks.

withTags.description: Include keyword tags in the response. Tags are used to group and categorize keywords in the project. Set to true to receive tag IDs and values for each keyword.

domain.description: Domain or URL to track. Accepts: 'domain.com' (tracks all URLs from this domain), 'subdomain.domain.com' (tracks specific subdomain), or full URL 'https://domain.com/page' (tracks specific page). Do NOT include protocol for domain-level tracking.

tools.name: get_site_audit_settings
tools.description: GET current settings of EXISTING audit project. USE WHEN: reviewing project config, before modifying settings. Returns: mainSettings, scan filters, auth, notifications, scheduling, error thresholds. Compare with get_site_audit_project_default_settings (template for NEW projects). Free.

projectId.description: Project ID to get settings for

tools.name: set_site_audit_settings
tools.description: UPDATE audit project configuration. USE WHEN: creating or modifying audit project. Get template from get_site_audit_project_default_settings first, modify, save with this method. Required: mainSettings, scanSetting (1=all site, 2=URL list, 3=sitemap), scheduleSettings, mailTriggerSettings, baseAuthBlock, keyword filters. Free.

projectId.description: Project ID to update settings for

scanSpeed.description: Scan speed (1-30, every increment of 3 adds one thread)

dontScanKeywordsBlock.description: Exclude pages with these keywords in URL

onlyScanKeywordsBlock.description: Only scan pages with these keywords in URL

scanSetting.description: Scan type and URL list settings

tools.name: start_site_audit
tools.description: START audit scan for project. USE WHEN: launching site crawl. Returns: reportId. Check progress with get_site_audits_list (progress field). **Cost: 1 credit/page (10 credits/page with JS rendering).** Wait for progress=100 before analyzing.

projectId.description: Project ID to start audit for

tools.name: stop_site_audit
tools.description: STOP active audit scan. USE WHEN: canceling crawl. Partial results may be available. Check get_site_audits_list for stopped status.

projectId.description: Project ID to stop audit for

tools.name: get_site_audit_results_by_categories
tools.description: GET aggregated error stats by category. USE WHEN: quick audit overview, identifying problem areas. Returns: error counts per category (highCount, mediumCount, lowCount, informationCount). Categories: pages_status, meta_tags, headings, content, multimedia, indexation, redirects, links, server_params, https, hreflang, amp, markup, pagespeed. For error details use get_site_audit_deteailed_report. Free.

reportId.description: Audit report ID to get statistics for

tools.name: get_site_audit_history
tools.description: TRACK specific error type trend over time. USE WHEN: verifying fixes, monitoring error growth. Returns: reportId, date, count per audit. errorName must match error.key from get_site_audit_deteailed_report (e.g., 'no_desc'). Free.

projectId.description: Project ID to get error history for

errorName.description: Error type name (e.g., h1_missing, no_desc, long_title)

limit.description: Number of history items to return

tools.name: get_site_audits_list
tools.description: **STARTING POINT for audit analysis.** LIST all audit reports for project. USE WHEN: finding reportId, checking audit status. Returns: reportId (for other methods), date, SDO score (0-100), pages scanned, issue counts, progress (0-100), hasDetailData flag. **TIP: sort by date for most recent.** Free.

projectId.description: Project ID to get audits list for

tools.name: get_site_audit_scanned_urls_list
tools.description: GET configured URL list for scanning (input config, not scan results). **ONLY works when scanSetting.type is 2 (URL list) or 3 (sitemap list).** Returns error for type=1 (scan all site). USE WHEN: checking scan URL configuration. For actual scanned page count use get_site_audits_list. Free.

projectId.description: Project ID to get scanned URLs list for

tools.name: get_site_audit_project_default_settings
tools.description: GET default template for NEW audit projects (not existing project settings). USE WHEN: creating new project, populating defaults. Workflow: 1) Call this, 2) Modify (set domain, name, limits), 3) Save with set_site_audit_settings. Defaults: pagesLimit=5000, scheduleRepeatOption=3 (weekly). No projectId required. Free.

tools.name: get_site_audit_bref_info
tools.description: GET quick audit summary (lightweight). USE WHEN: dashboard display, quick status check. Returns: SDO score (0-100), error counts by priority, pages scanned, progress, stopped/captcha flags. For details use get_site_audit_results_by_categories or get_site_audit_deteailed_report. Free.

reportId.description: The unique identifier for an audit report

tools.name: get_site_audit_deteailed_report
tools.description: GET complete error breakdown by categories. **Main method for detailed analysis.** USE WHEN: full audit review, error analysis. Returns: categories with errors (key, priority, countAll, countNew, countFixed). Use compareReportId for diff between audits. Use error.key with get_site_audit_history or get_site_audit_pages_spec_errors for drill-down. Free.

reportId.description: The unique identifier for an audit report

compareReportId.description: Another unique identifier for an audit report from the same project to compare

tools.name: get_site_audit_pages_spec_errors
tools.description: **DRILL-DOWN STEP 1:** GET pages/elements with specific error. USE WHEN: finding affected pages for an error. Returns: url, urlCrc/imageCrc (for step 2), count. Use CRC with get_site_audit_elements_with_issues for deeper analysis. Mode: 'all'|'new'|'solved' (vs compareReportId). Free.

reportId.description: The unique identifier for an audit report

compareReportId.description: Another unique identifier for an audit report from the same project to compare

projectId.description: The unique identifier for an audit site project

mode.description: Error display mode: all (all errors), new (new errors), solved (fixed errors)

limit.description: Count of returned items in response

tools.name: get_site_audit_elements_with_issues
tools.description: **DRILL-DOWN STEP 2:** Shows WHERE problematic element is used. USE WHEN: tracing error to pages. Use crc from get_site_audit_pages_spec_errors. **ONLY for hierarchical errors (images, scripts, links).** Returns 'Error don't have sub elements' for page-level errors (no_desc, h1_missing). Free.

reportId.description: The unique identifier for an audit report

compareReportId.description: Another unique identifier for an audit report from the same project to compare

projectId.description: The unique identifier for an audit site project

mode.description: Error display mode: all (all errors), new (new errors), solved (fixed errors)

limit.description: Count of returned items in response

tools.name: page_audit_start_scan
tools.description: SCAN single webpage with JS rendering. USE WHEN: page audit, on-page SEO check. Returns: pageId, reportId. Track with page_audit_get_reports_for_page. **Cost: 10 credits.** Wait for progress=100 before results.

userAgent.description: User agent ID. Recommended: 0 (Chrome) for most use cases. Values: 0=Chrome, 1=Serpstat, 2=Google, 3=Yandex, 4=Firefox, 5=IE

tools.name: page_audit_get_last_scans
tools.description: **STARTING POINT for page audits.** LIST all page audit projects. USE WHEN: finding pageId, listing audited pages. Returns: pageId (for other methods), url, name, status, lastActiveReport with SDO and counts. Free.

limit.description: Number of items to return (optional, default 30)

tools.name: page_audit_get_reports_for_page
tools.description: GET audit report history for page. USE WHEN: tracking scan completion, viewing past results. Returns: reportId, date, status (1=in progress, 3=finalizing, 4=completed), SDO, error counts, progress. **TIP: sort by date for most recent.** Free.

pageId.description: Page ID to get reports for

tools.name: page_audit_get_results_report
tools.description: GET detailed page audit results. USE WHEN: analyzing page issues, reviewing errors after scan. Returns: categories (errors by type: meta_tags, headings, content, multimedia, pagespeed), page data, report (SDO, counts). Each error has: key, priority, counts, hasAdditionRows (if true, drill down with page_audit_report_drill_down). Free.

pageId.description: Page ID to get audit results for. Use pageId from page_audit_get_last_scans or page_audit_start_scan response.

tools.name: page_audit_rescan
tools.description: RESCAN existing page audit. USE WHEN: re-checking after fixes. Returns: reportId. Track with page_audit_get_reports_for_page. **Cost: 10 credits.**

userAgent.description: User agent ID. Recommended: 0 (Chrome) for most use cases. Values: 0=Chrome, 1=Serpstat, 2=Google, 3=Yandex, 4=Firefox, 5=IE

tools.name: page_audit_stop
tools.description: STOP active page audit scan. USE WHEN: canceling scan. Returns: success boolean.

tools.name: page_audit_delete
tools.description: DELETE page audit project. USE WHEN: removing audit project. Returns: success boolean.

tools.name: page_audit_get_report_by_categories
tools.description: GET audit results by categories for report. USE WHEN: category-level analysis, comparing reports. Returns: categories with errors by type, page data. Use compareReportId for countNew/countFixed vs previous report. Free.

reportId.description: Report ID to get audit results for

compareReportId.description: Report ID to compare with (optional). When provided, countNew and countFixed will show differences between the two reports.

tools.name: page_audit_report_drill_down
tools.description: GET problematic elements for specific error. **ONLY works if hasAdditionRows=true** from page_audit_get_results_report. USE WHEN: drilling into error details. Returns error for hasAdditionRows=false. Response varies: multimedia errors -> image URL array; page-level errors -> page URL array. **Check hasAdditionRows flag first.** Free.

reportId.description: Report ID to get error details for

error.description: Error type key to get details for. Must match error.key value from page_audit_get_results_report response (e.g., image_no_alt, broken_image_url, large_image_size). Only works for errors where hasAdditionRows=true.

mode.description: Filter mode: all (all errors), new (errors added since compareReportId), solved (errors fixed since compareReportId). Optional, default is all.

compareReportId.description: Report ID to compare with for new/solved filtering (optional, required when mode is new or solved)

size.description: Number of results per page (optional, max 1000)

tools.name: page_audit_get_scan_names
tools.description: LIST page audit project names. USE WHEN: discovering projects. Returns: pageId, name, url, finishedReportCount. Free.

tools.name: page_audit_scan_logs
tools.description: GET scan event logs. USE WHEN: debugging scan issues, tracking progress. Returns: log items with message (audit_finish, crawl_start, etc), type (info/warning/error), params, timestamp. Supports pagination. Free.

reportId.description: Report ID to get logs for (required). If not specified, returns logs for all scans.

page.description: Page number for pagination (optional, default 0, starts from 0)

pageSize.description: Number of log items per page (optional, default 100)
